/leadership.title: Leadership | Mr. Mehroof I Manalody – Founder & Chairman of G-TEC EDUCATION
/leadership.text: class="hero-banner sub-page-hero"> Leadership Leadership Strong Leadership That Built A Global Education Network Mr. Mehroof I Manalody - The founder and Chairman and Managing Director of G-TEC EDUCATION is a Graduate in Economics from Madras University, and holds a Postgraduate Diploma in Computers. He has a very affirmative attitude and a forward-thinking mindset, and he possesses an exceptional ability to manage and grow educational and training institutions. He began his journey in the world of education by setting up computer institutes across the Malabar region. With passion and presistance, he expanded operations to other districts in Kerala, then to different states across India, and eventually took G-TEC to the global stage. In 2001, his dream of delivering quality education to everyone came to life as G-TEC. Since then, millions of students have gained employability skills through 800+ quality learning centers across the globe. G-TEC trains around 1,50,000 students every year, and this number continues to grow, It's all because of our quality service and expanding reach. G-TEC EDUCATION has taken the initiative to integrate IT and soft skill programs with university courses, aiming to bring the "finishing school" concept to life by developing innovative programs that prepare youth for sucessful careers. Under the leadership of Mr. Mehroof Manalody, G-TEC has proudly earned numerous IT excellence awards from both State and Central Governments, along with repeated international recognition from IAB(UK) through the UK Parliament for being the Best Centre, truly golden achievements in G-TEC's journey. His initiatives and innovations attracted national publicity through many national projects of Governments and gained him numerous awards like Brand Icon 2016, among the Top 10 entrepreneurs by Times of India and Economic Times. CMD's Message Mr.Mehroof Chairman & Managing Director "Education is the only path for self-fulfillment and self-realization. It is the only path to freedom and equality. We envision a world with peace and prosperity through educated minds with passion for enhancement of self and society" Our vision to deliver quality education across the globe gave birth to G-TEC in 2001. Since then, our mission has been clear: providing Quality Education for All, regardless of social, economic, or cultural background. From the beginning , we focused on helping people grow by offering training that connects education with real jobs. We provided access to International Certifications from top companies, all at an affordable cost. With G-TEC Professional Studies, we now offer approved university courses along with a wide variety of IT and skill-based programs. Many of these include International Certifications that strengthen our student's career path. We aim, "Making Professionals Globally", reflecting our focus on providing relevant, up-to-date training that aligns with industry needs. We also work closely with government bodies, universities, and international institutions to offer certified programs for those who need it most. We believe in giving quality education and staying updated with industry trends, and our courses are prepared through proper research so that our students get the best education. We also make sure our training is flexible and gives space for students to grow, while also fulfilling our responsibilities to society.

/privacypolicy.text: class="hero-banner sub-page-hero"> Privacy Policy Privacy Policy Effective Date: February 16, 2026 Last Updated: July 15, 2026 Who We Are G-TEC EDUCATION (“https://www.gteceducation.com/”) is operated by G-TEC Group of Institutions, an ISO-certified educational organization. We maintain this website as a service to our students, learners, and customers. By accessing or using our website and services, you acknowledge that you have read and agreed to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use. If you do not agree with these terms, please refrain from using our website or services. General This Privacy Policy outlines how G-TEC EDUCATION collects, uses, stores, and protects your personal information when you visit or transact on https://www.gteceducation.com/ (“Website”) and use our education, training, and support services. These terms constitute the entire agreement between you and G-TEC EDUCATION regarding your personal data and supersede any prior understandings. We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. If we make changes to this policy, we’ll update them here and show the new date. Please check this page once in a while to stay informed about how we keep your information safe. App Permission The G-TEC eLessons platform (available as a mobile app for Android/iOS and as a website) requires certain permissions to deliver a complete learning experience. Permission requests vary by platform: Camera – Used for attending live video classes, interacting with instructors, and uploading profile photos or image-based assignments Microphone – Required for participating in live audio/video sessions and submitting oral assignments or voice-based responses. Storage / Photos – Enables uploading assignments, attaching files to support requests, and downloading course materials or certificates to your device Notifications – Sends reminders for upcoming classes, assignment deadlines, course updates, and important announcements. Location – Used to personalize content based on your region, provide center-specific information, and improve user experience through regional analytics. Contacts – Allows you to easily invite friends or share course information through referral features (optional and user-initiated). Information We Collect We collect personal data and other information you provide when you register, enroll in courses, request support, or make payments on our platform. This includes: Personal Identification Information: Name, email address, phone number, postal address, date of birth, etc. Account Credentials: Username, password, and other authentication data. Payment Information: This includes your card details, billing address, and past payments. We use secure third-party services to handle all payments safely. Course and Usage Data: Records of courses purchased, progress, interactions, preferences, and feedback Communication Data: Messages, emails, and support requests you send to us. Device and Log Data: We collect basic information like the type of device you use, your IP address, browser, and activity on our site. This helps us keep things secure and make our services better Student/User Data Collection To provide and manage our educational services, we collect the following student data: Personal Information: Name, Email, Mobile number, Location, Student ID, Parent/guardian details, Institution name. Academic Data: Course enrolled, Attendance, Assignment submissions, Exam results, Learning progress. Technical Data: Device information, IP Address, App analytics (usage patterns and performance). How We Use Your Information Your information is used to: To provide and customize courses, training, and support for you. Process payments and fulfill transactions securely. Communicate important updates, service announcements, and customer support responses. Improve our website, services, and user experience. Follow the law and make sure our rules are followed. Prevent fraud and unauthorized activities. Children's Privacy Our platform is open to learners of all ages, including students under 18. We are committed to protecting children's privacy in compliance with applicable laws. Student under 18 may register only under the following conditions: Parental / Guardian Consent – A parent or legal guardian must provide verifiable consent before registration or data collection. Institution-Authorized Registration – Students may register through their educational institution, which acts as an authorized representative and ensures proper consent. Our Commitment: - We do not knowingly collect personal information from children without appropriate consent. - Parents or guardians may request access to, correction of, or deletion of their child's data by contacting us at info@gteceducation.com - We restrict data collection from children to what is strictly necessary for educational purposes. Live Classes Our platform offers live online classes with the following features: Recording: Live sessions may be recorded for quality assurance, training, and educational purposes. Accessibility: Recordings may be made available to students for later viewing as part of the course content. Attendance Tracking: Participation in live classes is tracked to monitor attendance and engagement. Storage: Videos may be saved or downloaded to your device for offline viewing, which will utilize your device storage. AI Features To enhance your learning experience, G-TEC eLessons may integrate Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies into our platform. These features are designed to provide personalized, efficient, and accessible education. 24/7 AI Chatbot Instant responses to queries, course guidance, and general support at any time. AI Tutors & Doubt Resolution Intelligent tutoring systems that provide real-time explanations and resolve academic doubts. Automated Assessments AI-generated quizzes, tests, and assignments with instant feedback and performance analysis. Personalized Learning Paths Custom learning journeys tailored to each student's goals, knowledge level, and preferred learning style. App Permission

  • Notifications – Sends reminders for upcoming classes, assignment deadlines, course updates, and important announcements.
  • Location – Used to personalize content based on your region, provide center-specific information, and improve user experience through regional analytics.
  • Contacts – Allows you to easily invite friends or share course information through referral features (optional and user-initiated).

Information We Collect

We collect personal data and other information you provide when you register, enroll in courses, request support, or make payments on our platform. This includes:
